notes: Manuscript page 16, with lighter archive folio 96 at lower left. The leaf starts in a continuing sentence and ends mid-word at nécessai-. No adjacent page has been consulted.

The prose allows the covering groupoid to be disconnected while explaining a geometric situation with X connected and X-prime K-connected. It describes E_0 as the fibre X-prime_{x_0}, with a transitive Gamma.Pi_0 action whose Pi_0 action need not be transitive.

Map (50) sends a point to its stabilizer; the following text asserts compatibility with inner automorphisms and passes to the quotient map (51). The components notation is explicitly explained below the display. The last paragraph introduces Theta acting by the given automorphism of Pi and begins an unfinished necessary-condition sentence.

This reader has transcribed these assertions and used their immediate roles to distinguish the components functor from the acting group. No independent proof, computation, or mathematical check event is claimed.

The source abbreviations, the blunt X-prime--X join, the braces in (51), the overbar-Sigma colon above the arrow, and the unfinished last word are preserved. The final la-like word is grammatically awkward and its deletion state remains uncertain; no grammatical repair has been made.

A compact cluster below the brace in (51) is retained as an explicit low-confidence alternative between a canceled Pi-like form and a reference/hash-like mark. The main reader checked the existing components51 crop and retained this ambiguity; it is not asserted to be a definite cancellation.

The capital-Pi transcription for group signs and calligraphic C readings agree with the supplied notation snapshot, but each occurrence on this leaf was read directly. Pure macro differences and archive/page-marker differences are excluded from substantive rows.

Main-reader check 142-097-R1 verifies descent of the stabilizer map: h fixes gx if and only if g^{-1}hg fixes x, so Stab(gx)=g Stab(x)g^{-1}. This gives a map from orbits to conjugacy classes. The locally explained component functor is written pi_0 while the acting group is Pi_0. The target of (51) visibly has unindexed Pi; no subscript is silently supplied.

The full independent second reading confirms all 43 comparison loci, 11 recorded decisions including seven assigned marks, four resolved certainty entries, both diagrams and all 12 inventory elements. All six inherited doubts remain. A first crop of i.e. independently confirms its internal and terminal points; main reader also inspected it. No text change, omitted element or mathematical check event.

check_events.outcome: Checked descent of the stabilizer map (50) to (51) for a left G-set E. An element h fixes gx exactly when g^{-1}hg fixes x; hence Stab(gx)=g Stab(x)g^{-1}. Therefore the conjugacy class of a stabilizer is constant on each G-orbit. The source of (51) is the set of components/orbits, denoted pi_0(E), whereas Pi denotes the acting group; this checks the distinction despite similar handwritten outlines. It does not repair the written omission of subscript 0 in the target of (51).
